text: {"quantities": [{"id": "q1", "value": 2, "unit": "", "kind": "count", "span": "the middle 2 shelves"}, {"id": "q2", "value": 10, "unit": "", "kind": "count", "span": "can hold 10 books"}, {"id": "q3", "value": 5, "unit": "", "kind": "count", "span": "5 fewer books than the bottom shelf"}, {"id": "q4", "value": 110, "unit": "", "kind": "count", "span": "she has 110 books"}, {"id": "q5", "value": 2, "unit": "", "kind": "count", "span": "twice as many books as a middle shelf"}], "plan": [{"op": "mul", "args": ["q1", "q2"], "out": "s1", "note": "combined capacity of the two middle shelves"}, {"op": "mul", "args": ["q5", "q2"], "out": "s2", "note": "bottom shelf capacity, twice a middle shelf's capacity"}, {"op": "sub", "args": ["s2", "q3"], "out": "s3", "note": "top shelf capacity, 5 fewer than the bottom shelf"}, {"op": "add", "args": ["s1", "s2"], "out": "s4", "note": "middle shelves plus bottom shelf capacity"}, {"op": "add", "args": ["s4", "s3"], "out": "s5", "note": "total book capacity of one bookcase (all four shelves)"}, {"op": "div", "args": ["q4", "s5"], "out": "s6", "note": "number of bookcases needed to hold all 110 books"}], "target": {"kind": "count", "scope": "how many bookcases Elly needs to hold all of her 110 books"}, "dismissed": []}
